name: bridge::spawn / Bridge

test_list.description: List on a fresh state dir returns Sessions(empty) without opening a kernel.
Open{resume:None} yields Starting then Opened; Submit{'plan tomorrow'} yields Committed and a Message{UserInput, 'plan tomorrow'} for the open session.
Submit{'$websearch(on)'} commits and streams Message{Directive, canonical text}.
Submit{'   '} yields Rejected with the kernel's reason and no Message.
Submit before Open yields Rejected('no session is open').
Close then Open{resume: Some(id)} replays the earlier Message for that session.
After a submit, List includes the session with the workspace path and an updated time within the last minute.
Dropping the request sender closes the open session and the bridge thread joins without error.

inputs.name: state_dir
inputs.description: Session store root (default <workspace>/.polaris/state, shared with the TUI).

output_description: Channel ends for the window and a handle that joins the bridge thread.
